summary: The dev paper baseline (bootstrap_dev_paper_baseline.py, persona market="US", symbol SPY) had no code-owned, durable market-data connector at all. Its only market input was a one-off operator-registered `static_records` connector (conn-dev-product-20260913T040439Z-...) injected during an unrelated 12-loop acceptance exercise (S5-LOOPS-001), whose event_time values were frozen absolute timestamps baked into its config. Frozen timestamps can never satisfy the flat age_seconds<=86400s admission rule again once they age out, so the runtime binding was paused with market_input_stale forever and every subsequent dev paper baseline attempt time out at PERSONA_PROVISIONING_READBACK_FAILED. Fixed by adding a governed, dev-only synthetic connector auto-provisioned and auto-scheduled by the existing persona_source_reconciler machinery (same pattern already used for TW official market data), whose event_time is always computed relative to "now" at ingest time, and by threading the paused binding's market_input_stale reason into the persona provisioning failure's terminal_reason so a future recurrence is self-diagnosing from the API response alone.

root_cause_investigation.method: Live SSH investigation of the dev VM (34.81.52.222) via `ssh -F /dev/null -i ~/.ssh/google_compute_engine chloe_ong_dev_cctech_support_com@34.81.52.222`, no redeploy performed.

GET http://127.0.0.1:18097/api/source-ingest/connectors/conn-dev-product-20260913T040439Z-7935481ca72f49629606e01098c3a54e shows provider="Explicit controlled simulation", fetch.mode="static_records", and its two records carry hardcoded normalized_row.event_time values (2026-09-12T03:59:39Z, 2026-09-13T03:59:39Z) baked directly into the stored fetch config -- not derived at ingest time.

docs/deployment/step5-acceptance-report.md and docs/deployment/evidence/S5-LOOPS-001/ confirm this connector id (acceptance_stimulus_id dev-product-20260913T040439Z-...) was manually injected as a one-off 'fresh stimulus' for an unrelated 12-loop acceptance exercise on 2026-09-13, not as durable paper-baseline market input.

services/source_ingestion/persona_source_reconciler.py's auto-provisioning reconciler (confirmed running continuously in dev via container logs: repeated POST /api/source-ingest/persona-source-provisioning/reconcile against pantheon-source-ingest-1) never manages this connector: _default_candidates() only returns candidates for market=="TW"; for market=="US" it returned [] before this fix, so the connector backing the persona's actual required dataset was entirely invisible to the self-healing reconcile loop.

The dev source-ingest scheduler container (pantheon-source-ingest-scheduler-1) runs controller_worker.py in RECONCILE_ONLY_MODE, which explicitly asserts 'reconcile_only mode must not select provider connector execution' -- so even a correctly scheduled connector performs no automatic background ingestion on this dev topology; the persona_source_reconciler's reconcile-driven auto-provisioning is the only durable, already-running self-healing path in this deployment.

services/paper_fleet_reconciler/paper_fleet_reconciler.py's admission check (services/execution/market_snapshot_admission.py:admit_market_snapshot) correctly rejects the frozen snapshot once age_seconds > max_age_seconds=86400, pauses the binding (session_admission.reason_code=market_input_stale), which starves the deployment saga at awaiting_binding until persona provisioning times out with PERSONA_PROVISIONING_READBACK_FAILED after PANTHEON_PERSONA_PROVISIONING_TIMEOUT_SECONDS (~600s) -- exactly the failure chain described in the task brief for deploy run 35312054524 / idempotency_key dev-paper-release-35312054524-1.

description: Added a lean, dev-only 'dev-paper-us-equity-simulation' connector (DevPaperUsEquitySimulationAdapter) whose event_time/available_time are always computed relative to the injected clock at call time (the most recently completed UTC daily close before now), never frozen into config. Every record and the connector itself carry is_real=false, provenance=simulation, mirroring the honesty conventions of the fixture it replaces. Gated to PANTHEON_ENV=dev via is_dev_environment().

Registered it as a ConnectorDefinition (definition_state=SUPPORTED) and wired it into persona_source_reconciler.py's _default_candidates/_provider_supports for market=='US' + dataset 'us_price_daily' + dev environment, following the exact pattern already used for the TW official connector. The reconciler's existing _ensure_schedule logic (cadence 'daily' -> interval_seconds=86400>0) auto-enables its schedule, so the already-running persona-source-provisioning reconcile loop keeps it fresh and self-healing with no further manual steps.

Added a required_data_sources entry for market=='US' personas under PANTHEON_ENV=dev in services/control-plane/bff/personas/service.py:_market_persona_required_data_sources, closing the gap where the dev paper baseline's persona previously derived no live_pull requirement at all for its market. Staging/prod personas are unaffected (still return [] for US).

Enriched the persona provisioning terminal_reason: when the RuntimeBinding a persona is waiting on is paused with metadata.session_admission.reason_code set (e.g. market_input_stale), that reason_code and its detail (source_snapshot_id, source_event_time, max_age_seconds) are now appended to the existing comma-joined provisioning_failure_reason/terminal_reason string, e.g. '...,runtime_binding_failed_or_mismatched,market_input_stale:source_snapshot_id=...,source_event_time=...,max_age_seconds=86400' -- additive only, no existing failure marker or schema was changed.
